quests.title: Echoes of the Unknown Gate
quests.summary: Uncover the ancient harmonic mystery linking the Crossroads, the Heart Tree, and the sealed Unknown Gate.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Maren at the Crossroads Settlement
Journey west and discover The Ancient Heart Tree
Awaken the Singing Obelisk puzzle in the valley ruins
Attune 3 Regional Waystones across the realm
Discover The Unknown Gate in the Hidden Frontier

quests.title: Herbs of the Emerald Canopy
quests.summary: Herbalist Lyra seeks luminous Moonpetals and Golden Sunberries to brew traveling tonics.

objectives.text: Gather Silver Moonpetals from the forest edge (2)

quests.title: Forge of the Old Kingdom
quests.summary: Blacksmith Torin can teach you to craft ancient weaponry once you recover sentinel parts and crystals.

objectives.text: Defeat a Stone Sentinel or Bramble Stalker
Craft any item or meal via Inventory -> Crafting

quests.title: The Cartographer's Horizon
quests.summary: Chart the diverse regions of the 8x8 km realm and uncover ancient landmarks hidden across the continent.
